import hashlib
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

ADB = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\platform-tools\adb.exe"
SERIAL = "R3CM400AKRX"
APK = r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1205\UltraCar_v1.2.05.apk"
ART_DIR = r"C:\Users\wdragons12x\.gemini\antigravity\brain\f4cd40d1-845a-4965-95af-0b0d9fdfa6f1"
PROBE_ART = os.path.join(ART_DIR, "scratch", "probe_art.py")


def adb(*args, check=True):
    cmd = [ADB, "-s", SERIAL] + list(args)
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
    if check and res.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ADB failed {' '.join(cmd)}:\n{res.stdout}\n{res.stderr}")
    return res.stdout.strip(), res.stderr.strip(), res.returncode


def screenshot(name):
    remote = f"/sdcard/{name}"
    local = os.path.join(ART_DIR, name)
    adb("shell", "screencap", "-p", remote)
    adb("pull", remote, local)
    adb("shell", "rm", "-f", remote)
    print(f"Screenshot saved: {local} ({os.path.getsize(local)} bytes)")


def screenshot_display(display_id, name):
    remote = f"/sdcard/{name}"
    local = os.path.join(ART_DIR, name)
    adb("shell", "screencap", "-d", str(display_id), "-p", remote)
    adb("pull", remote, local)
    adb("shell", "rm", "-f", remote)
    print(f"Display {display_id} screenshot saved: {local} ({os.path.getsize(local)} bytes)")


def main():
    assert os.path.isfile(APK), f"Missing APK: {APK}"
    with open(APK, "rb") as f:
        local_sha = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
    print("Local UltraCar_v1.2.05.apk SHA256:", local_sha)

    # 1. Remove stale diag artifacts from Builds_v1204
    for p in [
        r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1204\diag_stage",
        r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1204\diag.apk",
        r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1204\diag.apk.idsig",
        r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1204\diag_a.apk",
        r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1204\diag_u.apk",
    ]:
        if os.path.isdir(p):
            shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
        elif os.path.exists(p):
            os.remove(p)
    print("Cleaned stale Builds_v1204 diag artifacts.")

    # 2. Cleanly delete any leftover simulated display first
    adb("shell", "settings", "delete", "global", "overlay_display_devices", check=False)

    # 3. Install UltraCar_v1.2.05.apk
    out, err, rc = adb("install", "-r", APK)
    print("adb install -r:", out, err)

    pkg_path_out, _, _ = adb("shell", "pm", "path", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit")
    pkg_path = pkg_path_out.replace("package:", "").strip()
    dev_sha_out, _, _ = adb("shell", "sha256sum", pkg_path)
    dev_sha = dev_sha_out.split()[0].strip()
    assert dev_sha == local_sha, f"Device SHA {dev_sha} != local {local_sha}"
    print("Device base.apk SHA256 verified:", dev_sha)

    pkg_dump, _, _ = adb("shell", "dumpsys package com.tigeriq.dexsplit | grep -E 'versionCode|versionName'")
    print("Package info:\n" + pkg_dump)
    assert "versionCode=351" in pkg_dump and "versionName=1.2.05" in pkg_dump

    # 4. ART verify & speed AOT compile
    for mode in ("verify", "speed"):
        out, err, _ = adb("shell", "cmd", "package", "compile", "-f", "-m", mode, "com.tigeriq.dexsplit")
        print(f"cmd package compile -m {mode}: {out} {err}")
        assert "Success" in out, f"compile -m {mode} failed: {out} {err}"

    # 5. Run ART runtime unit test (probe_art.py)
    probe_res = subprocess.run(["python", PROBE_ART], capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
    print("=== probe_art.py ===\n" + probe_res.stdout + probe_res.stderr)
    assert probe_res.returncode == 0, f"probe_art.py failed with {probe_res.returncode}"

    # 6. Portrait UI live tests
    adb("shell", "am", "force-stop", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit")
    adb("shell", "logcat", "-c")
    adb("shell", "am", "start", "-n", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit/com.ultracar.dexsplit.ui.MainActivity")
    time.sleep(3)
    screenshot("v1205_cold.png")

    # Find floating button bounds via dumpsys window or fallback (116, 420)
    win_dump, _, _ = adb("shell", "dumpsys", "window", "windows")
    fx, fy = 116, 420
    m_win = re.search(r"Window\{[^\n]*com\.tigeriq\.dexsplit[^\n]*TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY.*?(?:mFrame|RequestedFrame|frame)=\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]", win_dump, re.S)
    if m_win:
        fx = (int(m_win.group(1)) + int(m_win.group(3))) // 2
        fy = (int(m_win.group(2)) + int(m_win.group(4))) // 2
    print(f"Tapping floating camera button at ({fx}, {fy})")
    adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(fx), str(fy))
    time.sleep(1.5)
    screenshot("v1205_float_on.png")

    # Toggle OFF via floating camera button
    adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(fx), str(fy))
    time.sleep(1.2)
    screenshot("v1205_float_off.png")

    # Tap bottom Camera tab (find via uiautomator if possible, fallback 882, 1968)
    adb("shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "/sdcard/v1205_ui.xml")
    ui_xml, _, _ = adb("shell", "cat", "/sdcard/v1205_ui.xml")
    cx, cy = 882, 1968
    m_cam = re.search(r'bounds="\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]"><node[^>]*text="Camera"', ui_xml)
    if not m_cam:
        m_cam = re.search(r'text="Camera"[^>]*bounds="\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]"', ui_xml)
    if m_cam:
        cx = (int(m_cam.group(1)) + int(m_cam.group(3))) // 2
        cy = max(1950, (int(m_cam.group(2)) + int(m_cam.group(4))) // 2)
    print(f"Tapping bottom Camera tab at ({cx}, {cy})")
    adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(cx), str(cy))
    time.sleep(1.5)
    screenshot("v1205_bottom_cam_tab.png")

    # Dismiss popup / toggle OFF
    adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(fx), str(fy))
    time.sleep(1)

    # 7. Secondary simulated display 1280x720/160
    adb("shell", "settings", "put", "global", "overlay_display_devices", "1280x720/160")
    time.sleep(2.5)
    disp_out, _, _ = adb("shell", "dumpsys display | grep -E 'mDisplayId=|Display [0-9]'")
    m_disp = re.findall(r"mDisplayId=(\d+)", disp_out)
    sec_id = max(int(x) for x in m_disp if int(x) != 0)
    print("Simulated secondary display ID:", sec_id)
    adb("shell", "am", "start", "--display", str(sec_id), "-n", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit/com.ultracar.dexsplit.ui.MainActivity")
    time.sleep(3)
    screenshot_display(sec_id, "v1205_sec_disp.png")

    # Tap bottom Camera tab on secondary display
    adb("shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "--display-id", str(sec_id), "/sdcard/v1205_sec_ui.xml", check=False)
    sec_xml, _, _ = adb("shell", "cat", "/sdcard/v1205_sec_ui.xml", check=False)
    scx, scy = 215, 660
    m_scam = re.search(r'text="Camera"[^>]*bounds="\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]"', sec_xml)
    if m_scam:
        scx = (int(m_scam.group(1)) + int(m_scam.group(3))) // 2
        scy = (int(m_scam.group(2)) + int(m_scam.group(4))) // 2
    print(f"Tapping Camera tab on display {sec_id} at ({scx}, {scy})")
    adb("shell", "input", "-d", str(sec_id), "tap", str(scx), str(scy))
    time.sleep(1.5)
    screenshot_display(sec_id, "v1205_sec_camtab.png")

    # Clean up simulated display
    adb("shell", "settings", "delete", "global", "overlay_display_devices")
    time.sleep(1)

    # 8. Inspect logcat for crashes/errors AND verify pid alive
    pid_out, _, _ = adb("shell", "pidof", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit", check=False)
    print("Final pidof com.tigeriq.dexsplit:", pid_out)
    logs, _, _ = adb("shell", "logcat", "-d")
    bad_lines = []
    bridge_lines = []
    for line in logs.splitlines():
        if re.search(r"FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|VerifyError|NoSuchMethodError|NoSuchFieldError|ClassCastException|SIGSEGV|SIGABRT", line):
            if "com.tigeriq" in line or "FATAL" in line or "AndroidRuntime" in line:
                bad_lines.append(line)
        if "TigerIQBridge" in line or "FloatingCamService" in line:
            bridge_lines.append(line)
    print("=== Bridge / FloatingCam logs ===")
    for bl in bridge_lines[-20:]:
        print(bl)
    print("=== Fatal / Exception matches:", len(bad_lines), "===")
    for bl in bad_lines:
        print(bl)
    assert len(bad_lines) == 0, f"Found crash/exception lines in logcat: {bad_lines}"

    main()

package ai.tigeriq.camera

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.tan

/** Kinematic bicycle model referenced to the rear axle; positions in metres.
 *
 * roadWheelDegrees is FRONT ROAD WHEEL angle (not steering wheel angle and not
 * gyro yaw rate). Right turn = positive x in rear-camera frame. For reverse
 * travel s, the rear axle traverses a circular arc with curvature tan(delta)/L.
 *
 * Values must be calibrated to the actual vehicle and the camera extrinsics
 * before displaying distances as measurements; default parameters are an
 * illustrative geometry model, not vehicle-certified values.
 */
object ReversePathGeometry {
    data class Corridor(
        val sMeters: Double,
        val centerX: Double,
        val centerBack: Double,
        val leftX: Double,
        val leftBack: Double,
        val rightX: Double,
        val rightBack: Double
    )

    data class TrackPoint(
        val x: Double,
        val back: Double
    )

    data class ScreenPoint(
        val x: Float,
        val y: Float
    )

    fun sample(
        distanceBack: Double,
        roadWheelDegrees: Double,
        wheelbaseMeters: Double,
        widthMeters: Double
    ): Corridor {
        require(distanceBack >= 0.0 && distanceBack <= 6.0)
        require(roadWheelDegrees in -40.0..40.0)
        require(wheelbaseMeters in 1.5..5.0)
        require(widthMeters in 1.2..3.0)
        val k = tan(roadWheelDegrees * PI / 180.0) / wheelbaseMeters
        val heading = k * distanceBack
        val x = if (abs(k) < 1e-9) 0.0 else (1.0 - cos(heading)) / k
        val backwards = if (abs(k) < 1e-9) distanceBack else sin(heading) / k
        val halfWidth = widthMeters * 0.5
        return Corridor(distanceBack, x, backwards,
            x - halfWidth * cos(heading), backwards + halfWidth * sin(heading),
            x + halfWidth * cos(heading), backwards - halfWidth * sin(heading))
    }

    /** Safe concentric offset point along rear-axle bicycle arc for any tire or body offset. */
    fun sampleTrackPoint(
        distanceBack: Double,
        roadWheelDegrees: Double,
        wheelbaseMeters: Double,
        lateralOffsetMeters: Double
    ): TrackPoint {
        val safeBack = distanceBack.coerceIn(0.0, 6.0)
        val safeAngle = roadWheelDegrees.coerceIn(-35.0, 35.0)
        val safeWheelbase = wheelbaseMeters.coerceIn(1.5, 5.0)
        val safeOffset = lateralOffsetMeters.coerceIn(-1.5, 1.5)
        val k = tan(safeAngle * PI / 180.0) / safeWheelbase
        val heading = k * safeBack
        val x = if (abs(k) < 1e-9) 0.0 else (1.0 - cos(heading)) / k
        val backwards = if (abs(k) < 1e-9) safeBack else sin(heading) / k
        return TrackPoint(
            x = x + safeOffset * cos(heading),
            back = backwards - safeOffset * sin(heading)
        )
    }

    /** Projects floor world meters (x right, back away from bumper) onto Canvas coordinates. */
    fun worldToScreen(
        worldX: Double,
        worldBack: Double,
        cx: Float,
        bottomY: Float,
        topY: Float,
        bottomHalfW: Float,
        topHalfW: Float,
        referenceDistanceBack: Double = 3.0,
        referenceHalfWidthMeters: Double = 0.90
    ): ScreenPoint {
        val safeBottomHalfW = bottomHalfW.coerceAtLeast(20f)
        val safeTopHalfW = topHalfW.coerceIn(10f, safeBottomHalfW * 0.92f)
        val ratio = safeBottomHalfW / safeTopHalfW
        val z0 = referenceDistanceBack.coerceAtLeast(0.5) / (ratio - 1.0)
        val zCam = worldBack.coerceAtLeast(0.05) + z0
        val tPersp = (z0 / zCam).toFloat()
        val perspSpan = 1f - (safeTopHalfW / safeBottomHalfW)
        val uY = (1f - tPersp) / perspSpan
        val screenY = bottomY - uY * (bottomY - topY)
        val pxPerMeter = (safeBottomHalfW * tPersp) / referenceHalfWidthMeters.coerceAtLeast(0.2).toFloat()
        return ScreenPoint(
            x = cx + worldX.toFloat() * pxPerMeter,
            y = screenY
        )
    }
}

122:  * with UVC road-texture motion gating to avoid stationary idle vibration & MEMS drift.
123:  */
124: class MotionSteeringEstimator {
125:     private var biasRadPerSec = 0f
126:     private var yawSlowRadPerSec = 0f
127:     private var lastGyroMs = 0L
128:     private var lastStepMs = 0L
129:     private var turnHoldStartMs = 0L
130:     private var turnHoldSign = 0
131:     private var baseDegrees = 0f
132: 
133:     @Volatile
134:     private var lastMotionScore = 0f
135: 
136:     @Volatile
137:     private var lastMotionMs = 0L
138: 
139:     @Synchronized
140:     fun reset() {
141:         yawSlowRadPerSec = 0f
142:         lastGyroMs = 0L
143:         lastStepMs = 0L
144:         turnHoldStartMs = 0L
145:         turnHoldSign = 0
146:         baseDegrees = 0f
147:     }
148: 
149:     fun onVideoMotionScore(score: Float, timestampMs: Long) {
150:         if (!score.isFinite() || score < 0f) return
151:         lastMotionScore = score
152:         lastMotionMs = timestampMs
153:     }
154: 
155:     @Synchronized
156:     fun onGyroSample(
157:         wx: Float,
158:         wy: Float,
159:         wz: Float,
160:         gx: Float,
161:         gy: Float,
162:         gz: Float,
163:         hasGravity: Boolean,
164:         timestampMs: Long
165:     ) {
166:         val gNormSq = gx * gx + gy * gy + gz * gz
167:         val rawYaw = if (hasGravity && gNormSq > 25f) {
168:             (wx * gx + wy * gy + wz * gz) / sqrt(gNormSq)
169:         } else {
170:             wy
171:         }
172:         if (!rawYaw.isFinite()) return
173:         val clampedYaw = rawYaw.coerceIn(-4.0f, 4.0f)
174: 
175:         val dtSec = if (lastGyroMs == 0L || timestampMs <= lastGyroMs) {
176:             0.03f
177:         } else {
178:             val delta = timestampMs - lastGyroMs
179:             if (delta > 1000L) {
180:                 yawSlowRadPerSec = 0f
181:                 turnHoldStartMs = 0L
182:                 turnHoldSign = 0
183:                 0.03f
184:             } else {
185:                 (delta.coerceIn(1L, 250L)) / 1000f
186:             }
187:         }
188:         lastGyroMs = timestampMs
189: 
190:         // Slow MEMS zero-offset bias tracking strictly when vehicle is calm.
191:         if (abs(clampedYaw - biasRadPerSec) < 0.028f && abs(yawSlowRadPerSec) < 0.035f) {
192:             val biasAlpha = (dtSec / 1.2f).coerceIn(0.005f, 0.05f)
193:             biasRadPerSec += biasAlpha * (clampedYaw - biasRadPerSec)
194:         }
195: 
196:         val cleanYaw = clampedYaw - biasRadPerSec
197:         val lpfAlpha = (dtSec / (0.14f + dtSec)).coerceIn(0.05f, 0.70f)
198:         yawSlowRadPerSec += lpfAlpha * (cleanYaw - yawSlowRadPerSec)
199: 
200:         val activeDeadband = resolveDeadband(timestampMs)
201:         val absYaw = abs(yawSlowRadPerSec)
202:         if (absYaw > activeDeadband) {
203:             val sign = if (yawSlowRadPerSec > 0f) 1 else -1
204:             if (sign != turnHoldSign) {
205:                 turnHoldSign = sign
206:                 turnHoldStartMs = timestampMs
207:             }
208:         } else {
209:             turnHoldSign = 0
210:             turnHoldStartMs = 0L
211:         }
212:     }
213: 
214:     @Synchronized
215:     fun step(nowMs: Long, inverted: Boolean): Float {
216:         val dtSec = if (lastStepMs == 0L || nowMs <= lastStepMs) {
217:             0.033f
218:         } else {
219:             (nowMs - lastStepMs).coerceIn(1L, 250L) / 1000f
220:         }
221:         lastStepMs = nowMs
222: 
223:         // If sensor stream goes silent briefly, decay curvature smoothly back to straight.
224:         if (lastGyroMs > 0L && nowMs - lastGyroMs > 450L) {
225:             val decayAlpha = (dtSec / (0.18f + dtSec)).coerceIn(0.05f, 0.7f)
226:             yawSlowRadPerSec *= (1f - decayAlpha)
227:             if (abs(yawSlowRadPerSec) < 0.01f) yawSlowRadPerSec = 0f
228:             turnHoldSign = 0
229:             turnHoldStartMs = 0L
230:         }
231: 
232:         val activeDeadband = resolveDeadband(nowMs)
233:         val confirmMs = resolveConfirmMs(nowMs)
234:         val absYaw = abs(yawSlowRadPerSec)
235:         val targetBase = if (
236:             turnHoldSign != 0 &&
237:             turnHoldStartMs > 0L &&
238:             absYaw > activeDeadband &&
239:             nowMs - turnHoldStartMs >= confirmMs
240:         ) {
241:             // Reversing clockwise around +gravity (yaw < 0) curves right (+) before inversion.
242:             val dir = if (yawSlowRadPerSec < 0f) 1f else -1f
243:             val strength = ((absYaw - activeDeadband) * 145f).coerceIn(0f, 32f)
244:             dir * strength
245:         } else {
246:             0f
247:         }
248: 
249:         val tau = when {
250:             targetBase == 0f -> 0.12f
251:             abs(targetBase) > abs(baseDegrees) -> 0.10f
252:             else -> 0.18f
253:         }
254:         val smoothAlpha = (dtSec / (tau + dtSec)).coerceIn(0.08f, 0.75f)
255:         baseDegrees += smoothAlpha * (targetBase - baseDegrees)
256:         if (abs(baseDegrees) < 0.35f && targetBase == 0f) {
257:             baseDegrees = 0f
258:         }
259:         return if (inverted) -baseDegrees else baseDegrees
260:     }
261: 
262:     private fun resolveDeadband(nowMs: Long): Float {
263:         val motionFresh = lastMotionMs > 0L && (nowMs - lastMotionMs) in 0L..600L
264:         if (!motionFresh) return 0.045f
265:         return when {
266:             lastMotionScore >= 2.8f -> 0.042f
267:             lastMotionScore < 1.0f -> 0.068f
268:             else -> 0.050f
269:         }
270:     }
271: 
272:     private fun resolveConfirmMs(nowMs: Long): Long {
273:         val motionFresh = lastMotionMs > 0L && (nowMs - lastMotionMs) in 0L..600L
274:         if (!motionFresh) return 80L
275:         return when {
276:             lastMotionScore >= 2.8f -> 30L
277:             lastMotionScore < 1.0f -> 130L
278:             else -> 75L
279:         }
280:     }
281: }

283: /** Resolves effective steering road-wheel degrees preserving strict authority priority. */
284: class GuideSteeringResolver {
285:     private var verifiedRoadWheelDegrees: Float? = null
286:     private var legacyExternalDegrees: Float? = null
287: 
288:     fun setVerifiedRoadWheelAngleDegrees(degrees: Float?) {
289:         verifiedRoadWheelDegrees = degrees?.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it in -35f..35f }
290:     }
291: 
292:     fun setLegacySteeringDegrees(degrees: Float, inverted: Boolean) {
293:         if (!degrees.isFinite() || abs(degrees) <= 0.5f) {
294:             legacyExternalDegrees = null
295:             return
296:         }
297:         val dir = if (inverted) -1f else 1f
298:         legacyExternalDegrees = (degrees / 15f * dir).coerceIn(-35f, 35f)
299:     }
300: 
301:     fun resolveTargetDegrees(motionDegrees: Float): Float {
302:         verifiedRoadWheelDegrees?.let { return it }
303:         legacyExternalDegrees?.let { return it }
304:         return motionDegrees.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.coerceIn(-35f, 35f) ?: 0f
305:     }
306: }

315: /**
316:  * Experimental signal evidence for the already available UVCAndroid IFrameCallback.
317:  *
318:  * Samples only Y (luma) bytes of NV21 frames. Retains no pixels or frame images.
319:  * Signal characteristics are NOT gear state. Dark reversing video is possible.
320:  * Deliberately NEVER opens or closes any window.
321:  */
322: object UvcFrameSignalEvidence {
323:     const val ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE = 32 // 8 cols x 4 rows across lower road band
324: 
325:     data class Metrics(
326:         val samples: Int,
327:         val meanLuma: Double,
328:         val lumaVariance: Double,
329:         val darkShare: Double,
330:         val occupiedLumaBins: Int
331:     ) {
332:         /** Diagnostic finding, not proof of signal loss or P/N/D. */
333:         val lowInformation: Boolean
334:             get() = lumaVariance < 5.0 && occupiedLumaBins <= 2
335:     }
336: 
337:     fun sampleNv21(frame: ByteBuffer, width: Int, height: Int): Metrics? {
338:         if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return null
339:         val pixelCountLong = width.toLong() * height.toLong()
340:         if (pixelCountLong > Int.MAX_VALUE) return null
341:         val pixelCount = pixelCountLong.toInt()
342:         if (frame.remaining() < pixelCount) return null
343:         val read = frame.asReadOnlyBuffer()
344:         val base = read.position()
345:         val stride = max(1, pixelCount / 1024)
346:         val bins = BooleanArray(16)
347:         var n = 0
348:         var dark = 0
349:         var sum = 0.0
350:         var squareSum = 0.0
351:         var i = 0
352:         while (i < pixelCount) {
353:             val y = read.get(base + i).toInt() and 0xFF
354:             n++
355:             sum += y
356:             squareSum += y.toDouble() * y
357:             if (y <= 16) dark++
358:             bins[y ushr 4] = true
359:             i += stride
360:         }
361:         val mean = sum / n
362:         return Metrics(
363:             samples = n,
364:             meanLuma = mean,
365:             lumaVariance = max(0.0, squareSum / n - mean * mean),
366:             darkShare = dark.toDouble() / n,
367:             occupiedLumaBins = bins.count { it }
368:         )
369:     }
370: 
371:     /**
372:      * Zero-allocation lower-road luma motion estimator immune to uniform AGC exposure jumps.
373:      * Writes 32 sampled Y bytes into [outSample] and compares zero-mean MAD against [previousSample].
374:      */
375:     fun computeRoadMotionScore(
376:         frame: ByteBuffer,
377:         width: Int,
378:         height: Int,
379:         previousSample: ByteArray,
380:         outSample: ByteArray
381:     ): Float? {
382:         if (width < 16 || height < 16) return null
383:         if (previousSample.size < ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE || outSample.size < ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE) return null
384:         val pixelCountLong = width.toLong() * height.toLong()
385:         if (pixelCountLong > Int.MAX_VALUE || frame.remaining() < pixelCountLong) return null
386: 
387:         val read = frame.asReadOnlyBuffer()
388:         val base = read.position()
389:         var idx = 0
390:         var sumCur = 0
391:         var sumPrev = 0
392: 
393:         for (row in 0 until 4) {
394:             val y = ((0.56f + row * 0.10f) * height).toInt().coerceIn(0, height - 1)
395:             val rowBase = base + y * width
396:             for (col in 0 until 8) {
397:                 val x = ((0.15f + col * 0.10f) * width).toInt().coerceIn(0, width - 1)
398:                 val lumaCur = read.get(rowBase + x).toInt() and 0xFF
399:                 val lumaPrev = previousSample[idx].toInt() and 0xFF
400:                 outSample[idx] = lumaCur.toByte()
401:                 sumCur += lumaCur
402:                 sumPrev += lumaPrev
403:                 idx++
404:             }
405:         }
406: 
407:         val meanCur = sumCur / ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE.toFloat()
408:         val meanPrev = sumPrev / ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE.toFloat()
409:         var mad = 0f
410:         for (i in 0 until ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE) {
411:             val cur = (outSample[i].toInt() and 0xFF) - meanCur
412:             val prev = (previousSample[i].toInt() and 0xFF) - meanPrev
413:             mad += abs(cur - prev)
414:         }
415:         return mad / ROAD_MOTION_GRID_SIZE.toFloat()
416:     }
417: }

707:     private val animateRunnable = object : Runnable {
708:         private var lastPrefSig = Int.MIN_VALUE
709:         override fun run() {
710:             val now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
711:             val prefSig = (settings.guidelineStyle * 31) xor
712:                 (settings.guidelineScale * 100f).toInt() xor
713:                 (if (settings.isOemWheelDistanceBarsEnabled) 0x10 else 0) xor
714:                 (if (settings.isGuidelinesEnabled) 0x20 else 0) xor
715:                 (if (settings.isMotionCurveEnabled) 0x40 else 0)
716:             val motionDeg = if (settings.isMotionCurveEnabled) {
717:                 motionEstimator.step(now, settings.isSteeringInverted)
718:             } else {
719:                 0f
720:             }
721:             val targetDeg = steeringResolver.resolveTargetDegrees(motionDeg)
722:             val prevDeg = currentWheelDegrees
723:             currentWheelDegrees += 0.35f * (targetDeg - currentWheelDegrees)
724:             if (abs(currentWheelDegrees) < 0.1f && abs(targetDeg) < 0.1f) {
725:                 currentWheelDegrees = 0f
726:             }
727:             curvature = currentWheelDegrees / 35f
728: 
729:             if (prefSig != lastPrefSig || abs(currentWheelDegrees - prevDeg) > 0.02f || abs(currentWheelDegrees) > 0.05f) {
730:                 lastPrefSig = prefSig
731:                 invalidate()
732:             }
733:             mainHandler.postDelayed(this, 33) // ~30 fps
734:         }
735:     }

753:             sensorManager = sm

801:     override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
802:         if (!settings.isGuidelinesEnabled) return
803: 
804:         val w = width
805:         val h = height
806:         if (w < 50 || h < 50) return
807: 
808:         val style = settings.guidelineStyle
809:         val scale = settings.guidelineScale.coerceIn(0.8f, 1.8f)
810:         val warp = settings.warpFactor
811: 
812:         val bottomY = h * 0.86f
813:         val topY = h * 0.38f
814: 
815:         val bottomHalfW = (w * 0.30f * scale).coerceIn(dp(60f), w * 0.38f)
816:         val topHalfW = (w * 0.13f * scale).coerceIn(dp(30f), w * 0.20f)
817: 
818:         val cx = w * 0.5f
819:         val maxShift = (w * 0.5f - bottomHalfW - dp(24f)).coerceAtLeast(dp(20f))
820:         val wheelAngle = currentWheelDegrees.toDouble().coerceIn(-35.0, 35.0)
821:         // Kinematic bicycle model: physically-grounded rear-axle movement.
822:         val pFull = ReversePathGeometry.sample(3.0, wheelAngle, 2.9, 1.8)
823:         val pMiddle = ReversePathGeometry.sample(1.5, wheelAngle, 2.9, 1.8)
824:         val shift = (pFull.centerX.toFloat() * topHalfW / 0.9f * warp)
825:             .coerceIn(-maxShift, maxShift)
826:         val midHalfW = (bottomHalfW + topHalfW) * 0.5f
827:         val midShift = (pMiddle.centerX.toFloat() * midHalfW / 0.9f * warp)
828:             .coerceIn(-maxShift, maxShift)
829: 
830:         val blX = cx - bottomHalfW
831:         val brX = cx + bottomHalfW
832:         val tlX = cx - topHalfW + shift
833:         val trX = cx + topHalfW + shift
834: 
835:         // Bezier centre at t=0.5 equals bicycle-model projected midpath.
836:         // C = 2*Pmid - (Pstart+Pend)/2. Preserve approved rail widths.
837:         val midY = (bottomY + topY) * 0.5f
838:         val ctrlShift = 2f * midShift - shift * 0.5f
839:         val ctrlLx = (cx - bottomHalfW + cx - topHalfW) * 0.5f + ctrlShift
840:         val ctrlRx = (cx + bottomHalfW + cx + topHalfW) * 0.5f + ctrlShift
841: 
842:         leftPath.reset()
843:         leftPath.moveTo(blX, bottomY)
844:         leftPath.quadTo(ctrlLx, midY, tlX, topY)
845: 
846:         rightPath.reset()
847:         rightPath.moveTo(brX, bottomY)
848:         rightPath.quadTo(ctrlRx, midY, trX, topY)
849: 
850:         when (style) {
851:             CameraSettings.STYLE_OEM_WHEEL -> {
852:                 drawOemWheelTrack(canvas, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW, wheelAngle, scale)
853:             }
854:             CameraSettings.STYLE_PORSCHE_GT -> {
855:                 drawPorscheGt(canvas, blX, brX, tlX, trX, ctrlLx, ctrlRx, bottomY, topY, scale)
856:             }
857:             CameraSettings.STYLE_AUDI_MATRIX -> {
858:                 drawAudiMatrix(canvas, blX, brX, tlX, trX, ctrlLx, ctrlRx, bottomY, topY, scale)
859:             }
860:             CameraSettings.STYLE_TESLA_CYBER -> {
861:                 drawTeslaCyber(canvas, blX, brX, tlX, trX, ctrlLx, ctrlRx, bottomY, topY, scale)
862:             }
863:             CameraSettings.STYLE_LUXURY_GOLD -> {
864:                 drawLuxuryOem(canvas, blX, brX, tlX, trX, ctrlLx, ctrlRx, bottomY, topY, scale)
865:             }
866:             else -> {
867:                 drawSportRacing(canvas, blX, brX, tlX, trX, ctrlLx, ctrlRx, bottomY, topY, scale)
868:             }
869:         }
870:     }

872:     /**
873:      * MẪU 6: Đường bánh xe OEM (2 viền thân xe mảnh + khe hở + 2 dải bánh xe xanh + thanh đỏ 0.5m cố định)
874:      */
875:     private fun drawOemWheelTrack(
876:         canvas: Canvas,
877:         cx: Float,
878:         bottomY: Float,
879:         topY: Float,
880:         bottomHalfW: Float,
881:         topHalfW: Float,
882:         wheelAngle: Double,
883:         scale: Float
884:     ) {
885:         val sMin = 0.35
886:         val sMax = 2.90
887:         val steps = 20
888:         val outerOffset = 0.92
889:         val tireOuterOffset = 0.84
890:         val tireInnerOffset = 0.56
891:         val warpDeg = (wheelAngle * settings.warpFactor.toDouble()).coerceIn(-35.0, 35.0)
892: 
893:         fun buildRibbon(innerU: Double, outerU: Double) {
894:             wheelRibbonPath.reset()
895:             for (i in 0..steps) {
896:                 val s = sMin + (sMax - sMin) * (i.toDouble() / steps)
897:                 val wt = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(s, warpDeg, 2.9, innerU)
898:                 val pt = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(wt.x, wt.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
899:                 if (i == 0) wheelRibbonPath.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y) else wheelRibbonPath.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y)
900:             }
901:             for (i in steps downTo 0) {
902:                 val s = sMin + (sMax - sMin) * (i.toDouble() / steps)
903:                 val wt = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(s, warpDeg, 2.9, outerU)
904:                 val pt = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(wt.x, wt.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
905:                 wheelRibbonPath.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y)
906:             }
907:             wheelRibbonPath.close()
908:             canvas.drawPath(wheelRibbonPath, wheelFillPaint)
909:             wheelEdgePaint.strokeWidth = dp(1.2f) * scale
910:             canvas.drawPath(wheelRibbonPath, wheelEdgePaint)
911:         }
912: 
913:         fun buildRail(path: Path, lateralU: Double) {
914:             path.reset()
915:             val railStart = sMin - 0.04
916:             val railEnd = sMax + 0.06
917:             for (i in 0..steps) {
918:                 val s = railStart + (railEnd - railStart) * (i.toDouble() / steps)
919:                 val wt = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(s, warpDeg, 2.9, lateralU)
920:                 val pt = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(wt.x, wt.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
921:                 if (i == 0) path.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y) else path.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y)
922:             }
923:             outerRailPaint.strokeWidth = dp(3.0f) * scale
924:             canvas.drawPath(path, outerRailPaint)
925:         }
926: 
927:         buildRibbon(-tireInnerOffset, -tireOuterOffset)
928:         buildRibbon(tireInnerOffset, tireOuterOffset)
929:         buildRail(leftPath, -outerOffset)
930:         buildRail(rightPath, outerOffset)
931: 
932:         val showMetricBars = settings.isOemWheelDistanceBarsEnabled
933:         if (showMetricBars) {
934:             linePaint.color = Color.argb(140, 255, 255, 255)
935:             linePaint.strokeWidth = dp(2.0f) * scale
936:             for (d in 0 until 7) {
937:                 val s1 = 0.45 + d * 0.34
938:                 val s2 = s1 + 0.17
939:                 if (s2 > sMax) break
940:                 val w1 = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(s1, warpDeg, 2.9, 0.0)
941:                 val w2 = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(s2, warpDeg, 2.9, 0.0)
942:                 val p1 = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(w1.x, w1.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
943:                 val p2 = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(w2.x, w2.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
944:                 canvas.drawLine(p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y, linePaint)
945:             }
946: 
947:             drawCurvedMetricBar(canvas, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW, warpDeg, 1.25, outerOffset, Color.rgb(234, 179, 8), "1.0m", scale)
948:             drawCurvedMetricBar(canvas, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW, warpDeg, 2.15, outerOffset, Color.rgb(34, 197, 94), "1.5m", scale)
949:         }
950: 
951:         // Fixed horizontal RED rear-bumper clearance bar (~0.5m, stays anchored to car bumper)
952:         val bLeft = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(-outerOffset, 0.48, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
953:         val bRight = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(outerOffset, 0.48, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
954:         linePaint.color = Color.rgb(244, 63, 94)
955:         linePaint.strokeWidth = dp(4.5f) * scale
956:         canvas.drawLine(bLeft.x, bLeft.y, bRight.x, bRight.y, linePaint)
957:         if (showMetricBars) {
958:             drawBadge(canvas, cx, bLeft.y, "0.5m", Color.rgb(244, 63, 94), scale)
959:         }
960:     }

962:     private fun drawCurvedMetricBar(
963:         canvas: Canvas,
964:         cx: Float,
965:         bottomY: Float,
966:         topY: Float,
967:         bottomHalfW: Float,
968:         topHalfW: Float,
969:         wheelAngle: Double,
970:         sMeters: Double,
971:         outerOffset: Double,
972:         color: Int,
973:         label: String,
974:         scale: Float
975:     ) {
976:         crossbarPath.reset()
977:         val segs = 12
978:         for (i in 0..segs) {
979:             val u = -outerOffset + (outerOffset * 2.0) * (i.toDouble() / segs)
980:             val wt = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(sMeters, wheelAngle, 2.9, u)
981:             val pt = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(wt.x, wt.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
982:             if (i == 0) crossbarPath.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y) else crossbarPath.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y)
983:         }
984:         linePaint.color = color
985:         linePaint.strokeWidth = dp(2.8f) * scale
986:         canvas.drawPath(crossbarPath, linePaint)
987: 
988:         val midW = ReversePathGeometry.sampleTrackPoint(sMeters, wheelAngle, 2.9, 0.0)
989:         val midP = ReversePathGeometry.worldToScreen(midW.x, midW.back, cx, bottomY, topY, bottomHalfW, topHalfW)
990:         drawBadge(canvas, midP.x, midP.y, label, color, scale)
991:     }

import hashlib
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

ADB = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\platform-tools\adb.exe"
SERIAL = "R3CM400AKRX"
STAGE = r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Staged_v1_0_75_TEST_316_MCP"
BUILD_ROOT = r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1206"
CLEAN_APK = os.path.join(BUILD_ROOT, "UltraCar_v1.2.06.apk")
DIAG_STAGE = os.path.join(BUILD_ROOT, "_tmp_diag_stage")
DIAG_U = os.path.join(BUILD_ROOT, "_tmp_diag_u.apk")
DIAG_A = os.path.join(BUILD_ROOT, "_tmp_diag_a.apk")
DIAG_APK = os.path.join(BUILD_ROOT, "_tmp_diag.apk")

APKTOOL_JAR = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\apktool.jar"
BUILD_TOOLS = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\AndroidBuildTools35\unpacked\android-15"
ZIPALIGN = os.path.join(BUILD_TOOLS, "zipalign.exe")
APKSIGNER = os.path.join(BUILD_TOOLS, "apksigner.bat")
KEYSTORE = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\debug.keystore"
ART_DIR = r"C:\Users\wdragons12x\.gemini\antigravity\brain\f4cd40d1-845a-4965-95af-0b0d9fdfa6f1"
PROBE_ART = os.path.join(ART_DIR, "scratch", "probe_v1206_art.py")


def adb(*args, check=True):
    cmd = [ADB, "-s", SERIAL] + list(args)
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
    if check and res.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ADB failed {' '.join(cmd)}:\n{res.stdout}\n{res.stderr}")
    return res.stdout.strip()


def run(cmd):
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
    if res.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"CMD failed {' '.join(cmd)}:\n{res.stdout}\n{res.stderr}")
    return res.stdout


def screenshot(name, display_id=None):
    remote = f"/sdcard/{name}"
    local = os.path.join(ART_DIR, name)
    if display_id is None:
        adb("shell", "screencap", "-p", remote)
    else:
        adb("shell", "screencap", "-d", str(display_id), "-p", remote)
    adb("pull", remote, local)
    adb("shell", "rm", "-f", remote)
    print(f"Screenshot: {local} ({os.path.getsize(local)} bytes)", flush=True)


def replace_exact(path, old, new):
    txt = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
    cnt = txt.count(old)
    assert cnt == 1, f"Expected 1 match in {path}, got {cnt}"
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(txt.replace(old, new, 1))


def check_logcat():
    logs = adb("shell", "logcat", "-d")
    bad = [
        l for l in logs.splitlines()
        if re.search(r"FATAL EXCEPTION|VerifyError|NoSuchMethodError|NoSuchFieldError|ClassCastException|SIGSEGV|SIGABRT", l)
        or ("AndroidRuntime" in l and re.search(r"Exception|Error|FATAL", l))
    ]
    print(f"Fatal/Exception logcat lines: {len(bad)}", flush=True)
    for b in bad:
        print(b, flush=True)
    assert len(bad) == 0, f"Logcat crash lines found: {bad}"


def main():
    assert os.path.isfile(CLEAN_APK), f"Missing APK: {CLEAN_APK}"
    clean_sha = hashlib.sha256(open(CLEAN_APK, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    print("Clean v1.2.06 SHA256:", clean_sha, flush=True)

    # Part A: Diag pass with pd0 + bd0(1280x720) to verify live Compose + NativeGuideWarpView + resize
    try:
        for p in (DIAG_STAGE, DIAG_U, DIAG_A, DIAG_APK, DIAG_APK + ".idsig"):
            if os.path.isdir(p):
                shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
            elif os.path.exists(p):
                os.remove(p)
        print("1. Building temporary 16:9 diag APK from v1.2.06 STAGE...", flush=True)
        shutil.copytree(STAGE, DIAG_STAGE)
        replace_exact(
            os.path.join(DIAG_STAGE, "smali", "pd0.smali"),
            "    invoke-virtual {v15}, Lod0;->getHasDevice()Z\n\n    move-result v14\n\n    if-nez v14, :cond_1d",
            "    invoke-virtual {v15}, Lod0;->getHasDevice()Z\n\n    move-result v14\n\n    if-eqz v14, :cond_1d",
        )
        replace_exact(
            os.path.join(DIAG_STAGE, "smali", "bd0.smali"),
            "    :cond_4\n    move v5, v7\n\n    :goto_2",
            "    :cond_4\n    const v5, 0x3fe38e39\n\n    :goto_2",
        )
        run(["java", "-jar", APKTOOL_JAR, "b", "-j", "8", DIAG_STAGE, "-o", DIAG_U])
        run([ZIPALIGN, "-f", "-v", "4", DIAG_U, DIAG_A])
        run([
            APKSIGNER, "sign",
            "--ks", KEYSTORE, "--ks-pass", "pass:android", "--key-pass", "pass:android",
            "--v2-signing-enabled", "true", "--v3-signing-enabled", "true",
            "--out", DIAG_APK, DIAG_A,
        ])
        adb("shell", "settings", "delete", "global", "overlay_display_devices", check=False)
        adb("install", "-r", DIAG_APK)
        adb("shell", "am", "force-stop", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit")
        adb("shell", "logcat", "-c")
        adb("shell", "am", "start", "-n", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit/com.ultracar.dexsplit.ui.MainActivity")
        time.sleep(3)

        # Open via floating Car-Rear button
        win_dump = adb("shell", "dumpsys", "window", "windows")
        fx, fy = 116, 420
        for block in re.split(r"(?=Window #)", win_dump):
            if "com.tigeriq.dexsplit" in block and "TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY" in block:
                m_fr = re.search(r"(?:mFrame|RequestedFrame|frame)=\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]", block)
                if m_fr:
                    w = int(m_fr.group(3)) - int(m_fr.group(1))
                    h = int(m_fr.group(4)) - int(m_fr.group(2))
                    if 60 <= w <= 260 and 60 <= h <= 260:
                        fx = (int(m_fr.group(1)) + int(m_fr.group(3))) // 2
                        fy = (int(m_fr.group(2)) + int(m_fr.group(4))) // 2
                        break
        adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(fx), str(fy))
        time.sleep(2)
        screenshot("diag_v1206_cam.png")

        # Test secondary 1280x720 DeX simulated display
        adb("shell", "settings", "put", "global", "overlay_display_devices", "1280x720/160")
        time.sleep(2.5)
        disp_out = adb("shell", "dumpsys display | grep -E 'mDisplayId='")
        sec_id = max(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"mDisplayId=(\d+)", disp_out) if int(x) != 0)
        adb("shell", "am", "start", "--display", str(sec_id), "-n", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit/com.ultracar.dexsplit.ui.MainActivity")
        time.sleep(2.5)
        adb("shell", "input", "-d", str(sec_id), "tap", "215", "660")
        time.sleep(2)
        screenshot("diag_v1206_sec_cam.png", display_id=sec_id)
        adb("shell", "settings", "delete", "global", "overlay_display_devices")
        time.sleep(1)
        check_logcat()
    finally:
        adb("shell", "settings", "delete", "global", "overlay_display_devices", check=False)
        for p in (DIAG_STAGE, DIAG_U, DIAG_A, DIAG_APK, DIAG_APK + ".idsig"):
            if os.path.isdir(p):
                shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
            elif os.path.exists(p):
                os.remove(p)

    # Part B: Install & verify CLEAN signed UltraCar_v1.2.06.apk
    print("2. Installing CLEAN UltraCar_v1.2.06.apk...", flush=True)
    adb("install", "-r", CLEAN_APK)
    pkg_path = adb("shell", "pm", "path", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit").replace("package:", "").strip()
    dev_sha = adb("shell", "sha256sum", pkg_path).split()[0].strip()
    assert dev_sha == clean_sha, f"Device SHA {dev_sha} != clean {clean_sha}"
    pkg_dump = adb("shell", "dumpsys package com.tigeriq.dexsplit | grep -E 'versionCode|versionName'")
    print(pkg_dump, flush=True)
    assert "versionCode=352" in pkg_dump and "versionName=1.2.06" in pkg_dump

    for mode in ("verify", "speed"):
        res = adb("shell", "cmd", "package", "compile", "-f", "-m", mode, "com.tigeriq.dexsplit")
        print(f"compile -m {mode}: {res}", flush=True)
        assert "Success" in res

    print("3. Running probe_v1206_art.py...", flush=True)
    run(["python", PROBE_ART])

    print("4. Running final clean UI check on v1.2.06...", flush=True)
    adb("shell", "am", "force-stop", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit")
    adb("shell", "logcat", "-c")
    adb("shell", "am", "start", "-n", "com.tigeriq.dexsplit/com.ultracar.dexsplit.ui.MainActivity")
    time.sleep(3)
    screenshot("v1206_cold.png")
    win_dump = adb("shell", "dumpsys", "window", "windows")
    fx, fy = 116, 420
    for block in re.split(r"(?=Window #)", win_dump):
        if "com.tigeriq.dexsplit" in block and "TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY" in block:
            m_fr = re.search(r"(?:mFrame|RequestedFrame|frame)=\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]", block)
            if m_fr:
                w = int(m_fr.group(3)) - int(m_fr.group(1))
                h = int(m_fr.group(4)) - int(m_fr.group(2))
                if 60 <= w <= 260 and 60 <= h <= 260:
                    fx = (int(m_fr.group(1)) + int(m_fr.group(3))) // 2
                    fy = (int(m_fr.group(2)) + int(m_fr.group(4))) // 2
                    break
    adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(fx), str(fy))
    time.sleep(1.5)
    screenshot("v1206_float_on.png")
    adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(fx), str(fy))
    time.sleep(1.2)
    screenshot("v1206_float_off.png")
    check_logcat()
    print("ALL_V1206_VERIFICATION_PASSED", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

python -c "
# Compute exact normalized coordinates of VinFast OEM guidelines in grid_oem.png:
# Camera feed box corners in grid_oem.png (tilted slightly due to phone angle):
# Top-left: (125, 68), Top-right: (885, 112), Bottom-left: (168, 705), Bottom-right: (850, 608)
# Let's map OEM guideline pixels via bilinear/projective normalization into [0..1] x [0..1] camera frame!
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

# Source quad in grid_oem.png (TL, TR, BR, BL):
src = np.array([[125, 68], [885, 112], [850, 608], [168, 705]], dtype=float)
# Projective homography H mapping (x, y) -> (u, v) in [0,1]x[0,1]
dst = np.array([[0, 0], [1, 0], [1, 1], [0, 1]], dtype=float)
A = []
for (x, y), (u, v) in zip(src, dst):
    A.append([-x, -y, -1, 0, 0, 0, u*x, u*y, u])
    A.append([0, 0, 0, -x, -y, -1, v*x, v*y, v])
_, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(np.array(A))
H = Vt[-1].reshape(3, 3)

def to_uv(pt):
    p = H @ np.array([pt[0], pt[1], 1.0])
    return (p[0]/p[2], p[1]/p[2])

pts = {
    'left_rail_bot': (225, 685),
    'left_tire_out_bot': (280, 675),
    'left_tire_in_bot': (325, 668),
    'right_tire_in_bot': (715, 622),
    'right_tire_out_bot': (755, 616),
    'right_rail_bot': (788, 610),
    'left_rail_top': (462, 345),
    'left_tire_top': (502, 355),
    'right_tire_top': (642, 352),
    'right_rail_top': (668, 345),
    'red_bar_left': (302, 560),
    'red_bar_right': (765, 495),
}
for k, pt in pts.items():
    u, v = to_uv(pt)
    print(f'{k:20s}: u={u:.3f}, v={v:.3f}')
"

import math
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

ART_DIR = r"C:\Users\wdragons12x\.gemini\antigravity\brain\f4cd40d1-845a-4965-95af-0b0d9fdfa6f1"
P_ULTRACAR = os.path.join(ART_DIR, ".user_uploaded", "media_1794379133147_29e1943f.jpg")
P_OEM = os.path.join(ART_DIR, ".user_uploaded", "media_1794379133526_09b9b254.jpg")


def clean_v1206_overlay(crop_img):
    """Lightweight cleanup of saturated v1.2.06 guide pixels on the asphalt for clean mockup visualization."""
    arr = np.array(crop_img, dtype=np.float32)
    h, w, _ = arr.shape
    r, g, b = arr[:, :, 0], arr[:, :, 1], arr[:, :, 2]

    # Restrict cleanup strictly to the old v1.2.06 guide region (x in 135..540, y in 230..450)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w]
    roi = (xx >= int(w * 0.19)) & (xx <= int(w * 0.80)) & (yy >= int(h * 0.42)) & (yy <= int(h * 0.82))

    sat_blue = (b - r > 32) & (b > 130)
    sat_red = (r - g > 48) & (r - b > 48) & (r > 135)
    sat_yellow = (r > 155) & (g > 130) & (r - b > 45)
    sat_green = (g - r > 18) & (g - b > 10) & (g > 125)
    dark_badge = (r < 55) & (g < 55) & (b < 55) & (xx > int(w * 0.65))
    white_dash = (r > 195) & (g > 195) & (b > 195) & (np.abs(xx - w * 0.5) < 12)

    mask = roi & (sat_blue | sat_red | sat_yellow | sat_green | dark_badge | white_dash)
    # Dilate mask by 2px so anti-aliased fringes are cleanly filled
    m2 = mask.copy()
    for dy in (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2):
        for dx in (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2):
            ys = np.clip(yy + dy, 0, h - 1)
            xs = np.clip(xx + dx, 0, w - 1)
            m2 |= mask[ys, xs]

    out = arr.copy()
    # Iterative horizontal/vertical nearest-valid diffusion inpaint
    valid = ~m2
    for _ in range(35):
        if np.all(valid):
            break
        nxt = out.copy()
        nxt_v = valid.copy()
        for dy, dx in ((0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0)):
            ys = np.clip(yy + dy, 0, h - 1)
            xs = np.clip(xx + dx, 0, w - 1)
            take = (~nxt_v) & valid[ys, xs]
            nxt[take] = out[ys, xs][take]
            nxt_v |= take
        out = nxt
        valid = nxt_v
    return Image.fromarray(np.clip(out, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8))


def sample_track_point(dist_back, wheel_deg, wheelbase, lateral_u):
    k = math.tan(math.radians(wheel_deg)) / wheelbase
    heading = k * dist_back
    if abs(k) < 1e-9:
        x = 0.0
        back = dist_back
    else:
        x = (1.0 - math.cos(heading)) / k
        back = math.sin(heading) / k
    return (x + lateral_u * math.cos(heading), back - lateral_u * math.sin(heading))


def world_to_screen(wx, wback, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw, ref_back=2.55, ref_hw=0.92):
    safe_bhw = max(20.0, bottom_hw)
    safe_thw = max(10.0, min(safe_bhw * 0.92, top_hw))
    ratio = safe_bhw / safe_thw
    z0 = ref_back / max(0.05, ratio - 1.0)
    z_cam = max(0.05, wback) + z0
    t_persp = z0 / z_cam
    persp_span = max(0.05, 1.0 - (safe_thw / safe_bhw))
    u_y = (1.0 - t_persp) / persp_span
    sy = bottom_y - u_y * (bottom_y - top_y)
    px_per_m = (safe_bhw * t_persp) / ref_hw
    return (cx + wx * px_per_m, sy)


def zone_color(y, y_red, y_yellow, y_green):
    """Smooth vertical gradient: Green (top/1.5m) -> Yellow (1.0m) -> Red (bottom/0.5m)."""
    c_green = np.array([34.0, 211.0, 118.0])
    c_yellow = np.array([250.0, 204.0, 21.0])
    c_red = np.array([244.0, 63.0, 94.0])
    if y <= y_green:
        rgb = c_green
    elif y <= y_yellow:
        t = (y - y_green) / max(1.0, y_yellow - y_green)
        rgb = c_green * (1.0 - t) + c_yellow * t
    elif y <= y_red:
        t = (y - y_yellow) / max(1.0, y_red - y_yellow)
        rgb = c_yellow * (1.0 - t) + c_red * t
    else:
        rgb = c_red
    return tuple(int(round(c)) for c in rgb)


def load_font(size):
    for p in (r"C:\Windows\Fonts\arialbd.ttf", r"C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeui.ttf"):
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()


def draw_proposed_guidelines(base_img, wheel_deg):
    w, h = base_img.size
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay, "RGBA")

    # Matched against OEM photo & ParkingGuidelinesOverlayView ratios
    bottom_y = h * 0.945
    top_y = h * 0.400
    bottom_hw = w * 0.405
    top_hw = w * 0.148
    cx = w * 0.495  # slightly centered cleanly for UltraCar frame
    wb = 2.9

    s_min = 0.05   # bottom bumper edge (y ~ 0.945h, below 0.5m bar!)
    s_max = 2.55   # top curb edge (y ~ 0.400h)
    outer_u = 0.92
    tire_out_u = 0.79
    tire_in_u = 0.61

    s_red = 0.48
    s_yellow = 1.22
    s_green = 2.02
    y_red = world_to_screen(0, s_red, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)[1]
    y_yellow = world_to_screen(0, s_yellow, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)[1]
    y_green = world_to_screen(0, s_green, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)[1]

    # 1. Translucent vertical gradient tire-track ribbons (Green -> Yellow -> Red), low opacity (~28% = alpha 72)
    segs = 44
    for sign in (-1.0, 1.0):
        u_in = sign * tire_in_u
        u_out = sign * tire_out_u
        for i in range(segs):
            sa = s_min + (s_max - s_min) * (i / segs)
            sb = s_min + (s_max - s_min) * ((i + 1) / segs)
            p_a1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sa, wheel_deg, wb, u_in), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p_a2 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sa, wheel_deg, wb, u_out), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p_b2 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sb, wheel_deg, wb, u_out), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p_b1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sb, wheel_deg, wb, u_in), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            ym = 0.5 * (p_a1[1] + p_b1[1])
            rgb = zone_color(ym, y_red, y_yellow, y_green)
            t_fade = (i + 0.5) / segs
            alpha = int(76 - 24 * t_fade)  # ~30% at bottom fading to ~20% at top so leaves/obstacles stay clear!
            dr.polygon([p_a1, p_a2, p_b2, p_b1], fill=rgb + (alpha,))
            # Soft glowing border edge
            dr.line([p_a1, p_b1], fill=rgb + (135,), width=1)
            dr.line([p_a2, p_b2], fill=rgb + (135,), width=1)

    # 2. Outer guard rails (sleek gap outside tire track), gradient color Green -> Yellow -> Red
    for sign in (-1.0, 1.0):
        u_rail = sign * outer_u
        for i in range(segs):
            sa = s_min - 0.02 + (s_max - s_min + 0.05) * (i / segs)
            sb = s_min - 0.02 + (s_max - s_min + 0.05) * ((i + 1) / segs)
            p0 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sa, wheel_deg, wb, u_rail), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sb, wheel_deg, wb, u_rail), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            ym = 0.5 * (p0[1] + p1[1])
            rgb = zone_color(ym, y_red, y_yellow, y_green)
            dr.line([p0, p1], fill=(0, 0, 0, 95), width=4)
            dr.line([p0, p1], fill=rgb + (210,), width=2)

    # 3. Center dashed trajectory line (đường tâm) along u = 0
    for d in range(9):
        s0 = 0.24 + d * 0.255
        s1 = min(s_max - 0.02, s0 + 0.135)
        if s0 >= s1:
            break
        sm = 0.5 * (s0 + s1)
        p0 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(s0, wheel_deg, wb, 0.0), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
        pm = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sm, wheel_deg, wb, 0.0), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
        p1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(s1, wheel_deg, wb, 0.0), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
        dr.line([p0, pm, p1], fill=(0, 0, 0, 115), width=4)
        dr.line([p0, pm, p1], fill=(255, 255, 255, 200), width=2)

    font = load_font(max(11, int(min(w, h) * 0.024)))

    def draw_side_badge(ax, ay, color, text):
        bbox = dr.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
        tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
        th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
        pw = tw + 12
        ph = th + 8
        bx = min(ax + 8 + pw * 0.5, w - 8 - pw * 0.5)
        by = ay
        if bx - pw * 0.5 > ax + 2:
            dr.line([(ax, by), (bx - pw * 0.5, by)], fill=color + (205,), width=2)
        rect = [bx - pw * 0.5, by - ph * 0.5, bx + pw * 0.5, by + ph * 0.5]
        dr.rounded_rectangle(rect, radius=5, fill=(10, 14, 24, 198), outline=color + (235,), width=2)
        dr.text((bx, by), text, font=font, fill=color + (255,), anchor="mm")

    # 4. Distance bars: 1.5m (green) and 1.0m (amber) curved along trajectory
    for s_m, col, lbl in [(s_green, (52, 211, 153), "1.5m"), (s_yellow, (250, 204, 21), "1.0m")]:
        pts = []
        for i in range(17):
            u = -outer_u + 2 * outer_u * (i / 16.0)
            pts.append(world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(s_m, wheel_deg, wb, u), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw))
        dr.line(pts, fill=(0, 0, 0, 95), width=4)
        dr.line(pts, fill=col + (205,), width=2)
        draw_side_badge(pts[-1][0], pts[-1][1], col, lbl)

    # 5. Fixed 0.5m Red bumper clearance bar (anchored straight to car bumper, rails extend below it!)
    rL = world_to_screen(-outer_u, s_red, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
    rR = world_to_screen(outer_u, s_red, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
    rCol = (244, 63, 94)
    dr.line([rL, rR], fill=(0, 0, 0, 115), width=5)
    dr.line([rL, rR], fill=rCol + (225,), width=3)
    draw_side_badge(rR[0], rR[1], rCol, "0.5m")

    return Image.alpha_composite(base_img.convert("RGBA"), overlay).convert("RGB")


def main():
    im_u = Image.open(P_ULTRACAR)
    im_oem = Image.open(P_OEM)

    # Crop UltraCar camera window cleanly (148..822, 64..614)
    cam_box = (148, 64, 822, 614)
    crop_u = im_u.crop(cam_box)
    clean_bg = clean_v1206_overlay(crop_u)

    # Render straight (0 deg) and curved (-22 deg) proposed mockups on real clean car video!
    mock_straight = draw_proposed_guidelines(clean_bg, 0.0)
    mock_curved = draw_proposed_guidelines(clean_bg, -22.0)

    # Re-apply UltraCar top-left X / Floating Car Icon / bottom-right resize corner onto mockups if needed
    # Wait: clean_v1206_overlay ONLY touched roi (y in 42%..82%), so the real red X, floating Car-Rear icon, and resize handle in crop_u are 100% preserved!

    # Resize OEM photo crop cleanly to same card size for clear 3-panel visual comparison
    oem_crop = im_oem.crop((118, 64, 888, 695)).resize(crop_u.size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

    pw, ph = crop_u.size
    pad = 16
    hdr = 42
    comp_w = pw * 2 + pad * 3
    comp_h = ph * 2 + hdr * 2 + pad * 3
    board = Image.new("RGB", (comp_w, comp_h), (15, 23, 42))
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    f_hdr = load_font(18)

    panels = [
        (pad, pad, oem_crop, "MẪU GỐC XE (OEM VinFast — đối chiếu kích thước)"),
        (pad * 2 + pw, pad, crop_u, "BẢN CŨ v1.2.06 (hẹp, cao, xanh đặc)"),
        (pad, pad * 2 + hdr + ph, mock_straight, "ĐỀ XUẤT MỚI — Thẳng 0° (khớp OEM + gradient + trong suốt + tâm)"),
        (pad * 2 + pw, pad * 2 + hdr + ph, mock_curved, "ĐỀ XUẤT MỚI — Bẻ lái -22° (uốn nhạy, 0.5m đỏ giữ thẳng)"),
    ]
    for x, y, img, title in panels:
        dr.text((x + 4, y + 8), title, font=f_hdr, fill=(241, 245, 249))
        board.paste(img, (x, y + hdr))

    out_comp = os.path.join(ART_DIR, "mockup_v1207_comparison.png")
    board.save(out_comp)
    mock_straight.save(os.path.join(ART_DIR, "mockup_v1207_straight.png"))
    mock_curved.save(os.path.join(ART_DIR, "mockup_v1207_curved.png"))
    print("Saved mockups to:", out_comp)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

11: def clean_v1206_overlay(crop_img):
12:     """Lightweight cleanup of saturated v1.2.06 guide pixels on the asphalt for clean mockup visualization."""
13:     arr = np.array(crop_img, dtype=np.float32)
14:     h, w, _ = arr.shape
15:     r, g, b = arr[:, :, 0], arr[:, :, 1], arr[:, :, 2]

17:     # Restrict cleanup strictly to the old v1.2.06 guide region (x in 135..540, y in 230..450)
18:     yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w]
19:     roi = (xx >= int(w * 0.19)) & (xx <= int(w * 0.80)) & (yy >= int(h * 0.42)) & (yy <= int(h * 0.82))
20: 
21:     sat_blue = (b - r > 32) & (b > 130)
22:     sat_red = (r - g > 48) & (r - b > 48) & (r > 135)
23:     sat_yellow = (r > 155) & (g > 130) & (r - b > 45)
24:     sat_green = (g - r > 18) & (g - b > 10) & (g > 125)
25:     dark_badge = (r < 55) & (g < 55) & (b < 55) & (xx > int(w * 0.65))
26:     white_dash = (r > 195) & (g > 195) & (b > 195) & (np.abs(xx - w * 0.5) < 12)

28:     mask = roi & (sat_blue | sat_red | sat_yellow | sat_green | dark_badge | white_dash)
29:     # Dilate mask by 2px so anti-aliased fringes are cleanly filled
30:     m2 = mask.copy()
31:     for dy in (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2):
32:         for dx in (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2):
33:             ys = np.clip(yy + dy, 0, h - 1)
34:             xs = np.clip(xx + dx, 0, w - 1)
35:             m2 |= mask[ys, xs]

import math
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

ART_DIR = r"C:\Users\wdragons12x\.gemini\antigravity\brain\f4cd40d1-845a-4965-95af-0b0d9fdfa6f1"
P_ULTRACAR = os.path.join(ART_DIR, ".user_uploaded", "media_1794379133147_29e1943f.jpg")
P_OEM = os.path.join(ART_DIR, ".user_uploaded", "media_1794379133526_09b9b254.jpg")


def clean_v1206_overlay(crop_img):
    """Smooth 2D harmonic inpainting of v1.2.06 overlay lines & pill labels so the mockup asphalt is clean."""
    arr = np.array(crop_img, dtype=np.float32)
    h, w, c = arr.shape
    r, g, b = arr[:, :, 0], arr[:, :, 1], arr[:, :, 2]

    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w]
    roi = (xx >= int(w * 0.16)) & (xx <= int(w * 0.89)) & (yy >= int(h * 0.40)) & (yy <= int(h * 0.85))

    sat_blue = (b - r > 28) & (b > 125)
    sat_red = (r - g > 42) & (r - b > 42) & (r > 120)
    sat_yellow = (r > 150) & (g > 125) & (r - b > 40)
    sat_green = (g - r > 15) & (g - b > 8) & (g > 118)
    # Catch all three black/colored pill labels (1.5m, 1.0m, 0.5m) on the right side
    dark_badge = (r < 68) & (g < 68) & (b < 68) & (xx > int(w * 0.62)) & (yy < int(h * 0.82))
    white_dash = (r > 190) & (g > 190) & (b > 190) & (np.abs(xx - w * 0.502) < 12)

    mask = roi & (sat_blue | sat_red | sat_yellow | sat_green | dark_badge | white_dash)

    # Dilate mask by 3px to cover anti-aliased fringes cleanly
    m2 = mask.copy()
    for dy in range(-3, 4):
        for dx in range(-3, 4):
            if dx * dx + dy * dy <= 10:
                ys = np.clip(yy + dy, 0, h - 1)
                xs = np.clip(xx + dx, 0, w - 1)
                m2 |= mask[ys, xs]

    out = arr.copy()
    # Initialize masked pixels by nearest-valid diffusion so Laplacian converges fast
    valid = ~m2
    filled = valid.copy()
    for _ in range(30):
        if np.all(filled):
            break
        nxt = out.copy()
        nxt_f = filled.copy()
        for dy, dx in ((0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0)):
            ys = np.clip(yy + dy, 0, h - 1)
            xs = np.clip(xx + dx, 0, w - 1)
            take = (~nxt_f) & filled[ys, xs]
            nxt[take] = out[ys, xs][take]
            nxt_f |= take
        out = nxt
        filled = nxt_f

    # 2D harmonic relaxation (Laplacian smoothing) inside masked regions -> zero horizontal streaks
    my, mx = np.where(m2)
    y_up = np.clip(my - 1, 0, h - 1)
    y_dn = np.clip(my + 1, 0, h - 1)
    x_lt = np.clip(mx - 1, 0, w - 1)
    x_rt = np.clip(mx + 1, 0, w - 1)
    y_up2 = np.clip(my - 2, 0, h - 1)
    y_dn2 = np.clip(my + 2, 0, h - 1)
    x_lt2 = np.clip(mx - 2, 0, w - 1)
    x_rt2 = np.clip(mx + 2, 0, w - 1)

    for _ in range(140):
        out[my, mx] = 0.25 * (
            out[y_up, mx] + out[y_dn, mx] + out[my, x_lt] + out[my, x_rt]
        )
    # Subtle second-order pass for natural road shading continuity
    for _ in range(40):
        out[my, mx] = (
            0.20 * (out[y_up, mx] + out[y_dn, mx] + out[my, x_lt] + out[my, x_rt])
            + 0.05 * (out[y_up2, mx] + out[y_dn2, mx] + out[my, x_lt2] + out[my, x_rt2])
        )

    # Match natural road texture subtly on large inpainted patches
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    noise = rng.normal(0.0, 2.2, size=(len(my), 1))
    out[my, mx] = np.clip(out[my, mx] + noise, 0, 255)
    return Image.fromarray(out.astype(np.uint8))


def sample_track_point(dist_back, wheel_deg, wheelbase, lateral_u):
    k = math.tan(math.radians(wheel_deg)) / wheelbase
    heading = k * dist_back
    if abs(k) < 1e-9:
        x = 0.0
        back = dist_back
    else:
        x = (1.0 - math.cos(heading)) / k
        back = math.sin(heading) / k
    return (x + lateral_u * math.cos(heading), back - lateral_u * math.sin(heading))


def world_to_screen(wx, wback, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw, ref_back=2.55, ref_hw=0.92):
    safe_bhw = max(20.0, bottom_hw)
    safe_thw = max(10.0, min(safe_bhw * 0.92, top_hw))
    ratio = safe_bhw / safe_thw
    z0 = ref_back / max(0.05, ratio - 1.0)
    z_cam = max(0.05, wback) + z0
    t_persp = z0 / z_cam
    persp_span = max(0.05, 1.0 - (safe_thw / safe_bhw))
    u_y = (1.0 - t_persp) / persp_span
    sy = bottom_y - u_y * (bottom_y - top_y)
    px_per_m = (safe_bhw * t_persp) / ref_hw
    return (cx + wx * px_per_m, sy)


def zone_color(y, y_red, y_yellow, y_green):
    """Smooth vertical gradient aligned to 3 distance bars: Green (top/1.5m) -> Yellow (1.0m) -> Red (0.5m/bottom)."""
    c_green = np.array([34.0, 211.0, 118.0])
    c_yellow = np.array([250.0, 204.0, 21.0])
    c_red = np.array([244.0, 63.0, 94.0])
    if y <= y_green:
        rgb = c_green
    elif y <= y_yellow:
        t = (y - y_green) / max(1.0, y_yellow - y_green)
        rgb = c_green * (1.0 - t) + c_yellow * t
    elif y <= y_red:
        t = (y - y_yellow) / max(1.0, y_red - y_yellow)
        rgb = c_yellow * (1.0 - t) + c_red * t
    else:
        rgb = c_red
    return tuple(int(round(c)) for c in rgb)


def load_font(size):
    for p in (r"C:\Windows\Fonts\arialbd.ttf", r"C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeui.ttf"):
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()


def draw_proposed_guidelines(base_img, wheel_deg):
    w, h = base_img.size
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay, "RGBA")

    # Calibrated from VinFast OEM screen homography & ParkingGuidelinesOverlayView ratios:
    # - Bottom rail span ~ 82.4% (bottom_hw = 0.412w) down to y = 0.955h (below 0.5m!)
    # - Top rail span ~ 25.6% (top_hw = 0.128w) up to y = 0.390h
    # - Slender tire tracks (0.67..0.80 of outer 0.92) with clear gap from outer rail like OEM
    bottom_y = h * 0.955
    top_y = h * 0.390
    bottom_hw = w * 0.412
    top_hw = w * 0.128
    cx = w * 0.495
    wb = 2.9

    s_min = 0.04   # bottom bumper edge (~0.95h)
    s_max = 2.55   # top edge (~0.39h)
    outer_u = 0.92
    tire_out_u = 0.80
    tire_in_u = 0.67

    s_red = 0.46    # sits near ~0.77h just above foreground leaves, tracks continue cleanly below it
    s_yellow = 1.20
    s_green = 2.00
    y_red = world_to_screen(0, s_red, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)[1]
    y_yellow = world_to_screen(0, s_yellow, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)[1]
    y_green = world_to_screen(0, s_green, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)[1]

    # 1. Translucent vertical gradient tire-track ribbons (Green -> Yellow -> Red), ~30% opacity (alpha 78 -> 68)
    segs = 52
    for sign in (-1.0, 1.0):
        u_in = sign * tire_in_u
        u_out = sign * tire_out_u
        for i in range(segs):
            sa = s_min + (s_max - s_min) * (i / segs)
            sb = s_min + (s_max - s_min) * ((i + 1) / segs)
            p_a1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sa, wheel_deg, wb, u_in), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p_a2 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sa, wheel_deg, wb, u_out), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p_b2 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sb, wheel_deg, wb, u_out), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p_b1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sb, wheel_deg, wb, u_in), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            ym = 0.5 * (p_a1[1] + p_b1[1])
            rgb = zone_color(ym, y_red, y_yellow, y_green)
            t_fade = (i + 0.5) / segs
            alpha = int(80 - 14 * t_fade)  # ~31% at bottom to ~26% at top: obstacles stay very easy to see!
            dr.polygon([p_a1, p_a2, p_b2, p_b1], fill=rgb + (alpha,))
            dr.line([p_a1, p_b1], fill=rgb + (150,), width=1)
            dr.line([p_a2, p_b2], fill=rgb + (150,), width=1)

    # 2. Outer guard rails (clear gap outside tire track like OEM), gradient Green -> Yellow -> Red
    for sign in (-1.0, 1.0):
        u_rail = sign * outer_u
        for i in range(segs):
            sa = s_min - 0.02 + (s_max - s_min + 0.04) * (i / segs)
            sb = s_min - 0.02 + (s_max - s_min + 0.04) * ((i + 1) / segs)
            p0 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sa, wheel_deg, wb, u_rail), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            p1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sb, wheel_deg, wb, u_rail), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
            ym = 0.5 * (p0[1] + p1[1])
            rgb = zone_color(ym, y_red, y_yellow, y_green)
            dr.line([p0, p1], fill=(0, 0, 0, 100), width=4)
            dr.line([p0, p1], fill=rgb + (225,), width=2)

    # 3. Center dashed trajectory line (đường tâm) along u = 0
    for d in range(9):
        s0 = 0.22 + d * 0.255
        s1 = min(s_max - 0.02, s0 + 0.135)
        if s0 >= s1:
            break
        sm = 0.5 * (s0 + s1)
        p0 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(s0, wheel_deg, wb, 0.0), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
        pm = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(sm, wheel_deg, wb, 0.0), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
        p1 = world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(s1, wheel_deg, wb, 0.0), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
        dr.line([p0, pm, p1], fill=(0, 0, 0, 120), width=4)
        dr.line([p0, pm, p1], fill=(255, 255, 255, 210), width=2)

    font = load_font(max(11, int(min(w, h) * 0.024)))

    def draw_side_badge(ax, ay, color, text):
        bbox = dr.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
        tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
        th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
        pw = tw + 12
        ph = th + 8
        bx = min(ax + 8 + pw * 0.5, w - 10 - pw * 0.5)
        by = ay
        if bx - pw * 0.5 > ax + 2:
            dr.line([(ax, by), (bx - pw * 0.5, by)], fill=color + (210,), width=2)
        rect = [bx - pw * 0.5, by - ph * 0.5, bx + pw * 0.5, by + ph * 0.5]
        dr.rounded_rectangle(rect, radius=5, fill=(10, 14, 24, 205), outline=color + (240,), width=2)
        dr.text((bx, by), text, font=font, fill=color + (255,), anchor="mm")

    # 4. Distance bars: 1.5m (green) and 1.0m (amber) curved along trajectory
    for s_m, col, lbl in [(s_green, (52, 211, 153), "1.5m"), (s_yellow, (250, 204, 21), "1.0m")]:
        pts = []
        for i in range(17):
            u = -outer_u + 2 * outer_u * (i / 16.0)
            pts.append(world_to_screen(*sample_track_point(s_m, wheel_deg, wb, u), cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw))
        dr.line(pts, fill=(0, 0, 0, 100), width=4)
        dr.line(pts, fill=col + (215,), width=2)
        draw_side_badge(pts[-1][0], pts[-1][1], col, lbl)

    # 5. Fixed 0.5m Red bumper clearance bar (anchored straight across outer rails; tire tracks extend below!)
    rL = world_to_screen(-outer_u, s_red, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
    rR = world_to_screen(outer_u, s_red, cx, bottom_y, top_y, bottom_hw, top_hw)
    rCol = (244, 63, 94)
    dr.line([rL, rR], fill=(0, 0, 0, 120), width=5)
    dr.line([rL, rR], fill=rCol + (235,), width=3)
    draw_side_badge(rR[0], rR[1], rCol, "0.5m")

    return Image.alpha_composite(base_img.convert("RGBA"), overlay).convert("RGB")


def main():
    im_u = Image.open(P_ULTRACAR)
    im_oem = Image.open(P_OEM)

    cam_box = (148, 64, 822, 614)
    crop_u = im_u.crop(cam_box)
    clean_bg = clean_v1206_overlay(crop_u)

def world_to_screen(worldBack, topY, bottomY, topHalfW, bottomHalfW, refBack):
    ratio = bottomHalfW / topHalfW

def calc(refBack, bhw=0.530, thw=0.165, ty=0.308, by=0.996):

   - Do **not** register a `MediaSession` callback to capture buttons, because holding an active `MediaSession` hijacks Spotify/Zing MP3/YouTube Play/Pause controls.
   - To preserve normal short-tap audio control (`< holdThresholdMs`), when the configured key is pressed (`ACTION_DOWN`, `repeatCount == 0`), intercept it (`return true`), start a runnable at `holdThresholdMs` (default e.g. `750ms`, user-configurable `400ms–1800ms`, strictly `< 2000ms`), fire `TigerIQBridge.toggleCamera()` cleanly once at `holdThresholdMs` (so camera opens immediately while holding `< 2s`, and repeat events/UP do not double-toggle!), and if released *before* `holdThresholdMs`, replay the original short press to Android (`AudioManager.adjustStreamVolume` for `KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP/DOWN` or `AudioManager.dispatchMediaKeyEvent(DOWN + UP)` / Voice intent bypass without re-triggering our own filter!).

jobs:
  contract:
    name: Validate release manifest without secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate version, filenames, certificate and SHA format
        run: python3 apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/verify_test_release.py
      - name: Guard against accidental release keys in the manifest
        run: |
          ! grep -Eiq '(BEGIN PRIVATE KEY|storePassword|keyPassword|keystoreBase64)' apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json

  sign-test:
    name: Sign TEST candidate only with provisioned GitHub environment secrets
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ultracar-test-release
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      KS_B64: ${{ secrets.ULTRACAR_TEST_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
      KS_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ULTRACAR_TEST_KEY_ALIAS }}
      KS_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ULTRACAR_TEST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
      KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ULTRACAR_TEST_KEY_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - name: Check signing credentials exist without exposing values
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for key in KS_B64 KS_ALIAS KS_PASSWORD KEY_PASSWORD; do
            if [ -z "${!key:-}" ]; then
              echo "SIGN_BLOCKED_MISSING_APPROVED_SECRET:$key"
              exit 31
            fi
          done
      - name: Verify unsigned candidate comes from a nonpublic draft release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/verify_test_release.py
          TAG=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["candidateDraftTag"])')
          NAME=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["alignedName"])')
          DRAFT=$(gh release view "$TAG" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft)
          test "$DRAFT" = true || { echo "CANDIDATE_RELEASE_MUST_BE_DRAFT"; exit 32; }
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar"
          gh release download "$TAG" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" -p "$NAME" -D "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar"
          python3 apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/verify_test_release.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/$NAME"
      - name: Install Android build tools 35
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
          test -x "$SDKMANAGER"
          yes | "$SDKMANAGER" "build-tools;35.0.0" >/dev/null || test -x "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0/apksigner"
          test -x "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0/apksigner"
          test -x "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0/zipalign"
          test -x "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt2"
      - name: Sign with installed matching key; validate package, schemes and pinned certificate
        id: sign
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar"
          sdk="$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0"
          manifest="apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"
          ALIGNED=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["alignedName"])')
          SIGNED=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["signedName"])')
          VERSION_CODE=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["versionCode"])')
          VERSION_NAME=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["versionName"])')
          PACKAGE=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["packageName"])')
          CERT=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("apps/ultracarhcm-v1/release/test-release-manifest.json"))["certificateSHA256"])')
          "$sdk/zipalign" -c -p 4 "$source_dir/$ALIGNED"
          "$sdk/aapt2" dump badging "$source_dir/$ALIGNED" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/badging.txt"
          grep -F "name='$PACKAGE'" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/badging.txt" >/dev/null
          grep -F "versionCode='$VERSION_CODE'" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/badging.txt" >/dev/null
          grep -F "versionName='$VERSION_NAME'" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/badging.txt" >/dev/null
          umask 077
          keyfile="$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/signing.keystore"
          printf "%s" "$KS_B64" | base64 --decode > "$keyfile"
          trap 'rm -f "$keyfile"' EXIT
          "$sdk/apksigner" sign --ks "$keyfile" --ks-key-alias "$KS_ALIAS" --ks-pass env:KS_PASSWORD --key-pass env:KEY_PASSWORD --v2-signing-enabled true --v3-signing-enabled true --out "$source_dir/$SIGNED" "$source_dir/$ALIGNED"
          "$sdk/apksigner" verify --verbose --print-certs "$source_dir/$SIGNED" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/signer-report.txt"
          grep -E "Verified using v2 scheme.*true" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/signer-report.txt" >/dev/null
          grep -E "Verified using v3 scheme.*true" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/signer-report.txt" >/dev/null
          grep -Fi "Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: $CERT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/ultracar/signer-report.txt" >/dev/null
          sha256sum "$source_dir/$SIGNED" > "$source_dir/$SIGNED.sha256"
          echo "SIGN_PASS_ARTIFACT_ONLY_DRIVE_NOT_VERIFIED"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: steps.sign.outcome == 'success'
        with:
          name: ultracar-v1-test-signed-candidate
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ultracar/*_signed_TEST.apk
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ultracar/*_signed_TEST.apk.sha256
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error

def sync_github_and_dashboard(signed_apk, dry_run=False):
    assert os.path.isfile(signed_apk), f"Signed APK missing: {signed_apk}"

        sha256_hex = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest().upper()

    sync_script = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "apps", "ultracarhcm-v1", "release", "sync-ultracar-status.mjs")
    if dry_run:
        log(f"[DRY-RUN] Would push UltraCar_latest.apk to apk-dist, sync release v1.2.13, and run {sync_script}")
        return

    dist_tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ultracar_apk_dist_")
    try:
        run_cmd(["git", "clone", "--depth", "1", "--branch", "apk-dist", "https://github.com/newsdayads/tigeriq-ai-lab.git", dist_tmp])
        dst_apk = os.path.join(dist_tmp, "UltraCar_latest.apk")

        status = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "status", "--porcelain"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
        if status:

            run_cmd(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "commit", "-m", "Publish TigerIQ UltraCar v1.2.13 (Build 359)"])
            run_cmd(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "push", "origin", "apk-dist"])
        else:
            log("apk-dist UltraCar_latest.apk already matches SHA-256; skipping push.")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(dist_tmp, ignore_errors=True)

    if os.path.isfile(sync_script):
        run_cmd(["node", sync_script, "--apply", "--comment", "--issue", "5129", "--root", REPO_ROOT])
    else:
        log(f"WARNING: {sync_script} not present on root checkout; push PR/main first so GitHub workflow syncs #5129.")


def main():

The calculations show that if `relLeft > 0`, `halfGap` is added to the left coordinate. If `relRight < 1`, `halfGap` is subtracted from the right coordinate. This confirms the gap implementation for adjacent windows.

Analysis reveals `gapPx` is derived from `windowGapDp` scaled by screen density; with a default of 13.5dp, the gap scales with device density.
