def log(msg):
    ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    print(f"[{ts}] {msg}", flush=True)


def run_cmd(cmd, cwd=None):
    log(f"CMD: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        log(f"STDOUT:\n{res.stdout}")
        log(f"STDERR:\n{res.stderr}")
        raise RuntimeError(f"Command failed (code {res.returncode}): {' '.join(cmd)}")
    return res.stdout


def replace_exact(path, old, new):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()
    if old not in content:
        raise ValueError(f"Pattern not found in {path}:\n{old[:120]}...")
    content = content.replace(old, new, 1)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(content)
    log(f"Patched: {path}")


def stage_clean_source():
    log(f"1. Staging clean source from {SOURCE_STAGE} to {STAGE}...")
    if os.path.exists(STAGE):
        log(f"Removing existing {STAGE}...")
        shutil.rmtree(STAGE)
    os.makedirs(BUILD_ROOT, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copytree(SOURCE_STAGE, STAGE)
    log("Stage copy complete.")


def patch_smali_fixes():
    log("2. Applying smali fixes for zero-gap window alignment & reserve strip logic...")

    # Fix 1: gz2.smali
    p_gz2 = os.path.join(STAGE, "smali", "gz2.smali")
    old_gz2 = """    sget v4, Landroid/os/Build$VERSION;->SDK_INT:I

    const/16 v5, 0x24

    const/4 v6, 0x0

    if-lt v4, v5, :cond_1

    if-eqz v3, :cond_1

    iget-boolean v4, v0, Lwx2;->X:Z

    if-eqz v4, :cond_0

    goto :goto_1

    :cond_0
    :goto_0
    move v4, v6

    iget v4, v0, Lwx2;->a0:I

    if-eqz v4, :cond_0

    iget v4, v0, Lwx2;->a0:I

    if-gez v4, :cond_2

    :cond_0
    :goto_0
    move v4, v6

    p_qy2 = os.path.join(STAGE, "smali", "qy2.smali")
    old_qy2 = """    sget v14, Landroid/os/Build$VERSION;->SDK_INT:I

def publish_to_drive(signed_apk):
    assert os.path.isfile(signed_apk), f"Signed APK missing: {signed_apk}"
    log(f"7. Archiving old Drive APKs into {DRIVE_ARCHIVE} and publishing {FINAL_APK_NAME}...")
    os.makedirs(DRIVE_ARCHIVE, exist_ok=True)
    for item in os.listdir(DRIVE_ROOT):
        if item.lower().endswith(".apk"):
            src_old = os.path.join(DRIVE_ROOT, item)
            dst_old = os.path.join(DRIVE_ARCHIVE, item)
            if os.path.exists(dst_old):
                ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                dst_old = os.path.join(DRIVE_ARCHIVE, f"{os.path.splitext(item)[0]}_{ts}.apk")
            shutil.move(src_old, dst_old)
            log(f"Archived previous Drive APK: {src_old} -> {dst_old}")

    drive_final = os.path.join(DRIVE_ROOT, FINAL_APK_NAME)
    shutil.copy2(signed_apk, drive_final)
    remaining_apks = [f for f in os.listdir(DRIVE_ROOT) if f.lower().endswith(".apk")]
    assert remaining_apks == [FINAL_APK_NAME], f"Unexpected APKs in Drive root: {remaining_apks}"
    log(f"PUBLISHED OK: {drive_final} ({os.path.getsize(drive_final):,} bytes)")
    log(f"Drive root APK check PASSED: {remaining_apks}")


def push_apk_dist(signed_apk):
    assert os.path.isfile(signed_apk), f"Signed APK missing: {signed_apk}"
    log(f"8. Pushing {FINAL_APK_NAME} to GitHub apk-dist branch...")
    dist_tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ultracar_apk_dist_")
    try:
        run_cmd(["git", "clone", "--depth", "1", "--branch", "apk-dist", "https://github.com/newsdayads/tigeriq-ai-lab.git", dist_tmp])
        dst_apk = os.path.join(dist_tmp, "UltraCar_latest.apk")
        shutil.copy2(signed_apk, dst_apk)
        status = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "status", "--porcelain"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
        if status:
            run_cmd(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "add", "UltraCar_latest.apk"])
            run_cmd(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "commit", "-m", f"Publish TigerIQ {FINAL_APK_NAME} (Build {VERSION_CODE})"])
            run_cmd(["git", "-C", dist_tmp, "push", "origin", "apk-dist"])
            log("Pushed UltraCar_latest.apk to origin/apk-dist successfully.")
        else:
            log("apk-dist UltraCar_latest.apk already identical; push skipped.")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(dist_tmp, ignore_errors=True)


def create_github_release(signed_apk):
    assert os.path.isfile(signed_apk), f"Signed APK missing: {signed_apk}"
    tag = f"v{VERSION_NAME}"
    title = f"TigerIQ UltraCar v{VERSION_NAME} (Build {VERSION_CODE})"
    notes = (
        f"TigerIQ UltraCar v{VERSION_NAME} (Build {VERSION_CODE})\n\n"
        "- Sửa dứt điểm lỗi dư dải lề/khe hở bất đối xứng một bên màn hình trên Samsung DeX (Galaxy Z Fold 2 / Android 13).\n"
        "- Gỡ bỏ điều kiện ngược Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 36 trong gz2.smali, rw2.smali, qy2.smali; liên kết trực tiếp với cờ cài đặt dexReserveStrip (mặc định = false -> 100% full width, xOffset = 0).\n"
        "- Giữ nguyên tính năng gán phím Remote Bluetooth & camera popup không che app nền."
    )
    log(f"9. Creating GitHub Release {tag}...")
    run_cmd([
        "gh", "release", "create", tag,
        signed_apk,
        "--title", title,
        "--notes", notes,
    ])
    log(f"GitHub Release {tag} created successfully.")

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--build-only", action="store_true")

    if not args.build_only:
        publish_to_drive(signed_apk)
        push_apk_dist(signed_apk)
        create_github_release(signed_apk)
